teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: time, clock, hour, minute, half, quarter, past, to, morning, afternoon, night, noon

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
time, clock, hour, minute, half, quarter, past, to, morning, afternoon, night, noon
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What time is it? (asking time)
• It is nine o'clock sharp (stating exact hour)
• It is quarter past ten (stating minutes past)
• See you at three PM (arranging time)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Stress and link in 'quarter past' /ˈkwɔː.tə pɑːst/.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Stress and link in 'quarter past' /ˈkwɔː.tə pɑːst/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Asking & Telling Time ('What time is it?', 'It is 8 o'clock', 'It is half past eight')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Asking & Telling Time ('What time is it?', 'It is 8 o'clock', 'It is half past eight')
Controlled Practice:
The long hand is on 6 and short hand is on 8. What time is it?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Excuse me, what time is it?
B: It is half past eight.
A: Thank you! Does the bus come at nine o'clock?
B: Yes, in exactly thirty minutes.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to four clock chime announcements and match each speaker to the correct time.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can ask for and tell the time in hours and minutes.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can ask for and tell the time in hours and minutes.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.
